title: Stability of Brenier maps
description: For the uniform measure on a convex body, quadratic optimal transport maps depend on the target in a one-third Hölder way for the Wasserstein distance, with one constant for all targets in a fixed compact set. The exponent one third is optimal, already on a cube with three-atom targets, which disproves a conjectured square-root estimate. The proof: derivatives of Laguerre cells; a uniform estimate of moment changes by mass changes, from a midpoint coupling by Knothe's rearrangement; moving the sites of finite targets with fixed masses keeps the potentials within O(W_2); a slice interpolation inequality turns this into the exponent one third. Proved in full in the programme, with no named hypothesis. The course is an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026).
